We have started to get multiple spam posts on https://es.discourse.group/ every day.

they always follow the same format:
new user, first post, reply to existing thread, says something a bit related to the thread but mostly confusing tech speak and then something like:

"more thoughts here:"

and a link like:

something.pages.dev/r/es_discourse_group
